newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece's Xiosbank makes trade debut May 26.
newsitem.headline: Greece's Xiosbank makes trade debut May 26.

text.p: Xiosbank, which went public in mid-April, makes its trading debut on the Athens bourse's main market on Monday May 26. It started at 2,650 drachmas a share.
A technical hitch delayed the bourse's opening on Monday.
Under recent bourse regulations the 8.0 percent daily volatility limit will not apply during the first three trading sessions.
Xiosbank's IPO was oversubscribed 133 times as regards the tranche offered to the retail investment public. The portion that went to institutional investors was oversubscribed 63 times.
The bank raised 4.43 billion drachmas with a good chunk placed with foreign institutional investors.
A total of 7,962,220 shares will be listed.

Xiosbank will use IPO proceeds to finance its investment programme for the period 1997-2000 which calls for an expansion of its network to a total of 45 branches by the year 2000 from 25 currently. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
